description: Deterministic launch-readiness rules for generated product. Every finding maps to a Phase 3.8E manualEdits category and names the specialist role that owns the fix, so a predicted edit is actionable rather than a complaint. The point is to spend the 20-edit budget on judgement a person actually has to make, not on gaps a script can name first.
rules: A finding is a prediction that a human would otherwise have to make this edit by hand. Categories match schemas/genuine-business-acceptance.schema.json so predicted and actual edits are directly comparable.
Severity is about launchability, not taste. blocker: the site should not go live. major: a reviewer will almost certainly change this. minor: worth knowing, not worth blocking.
Every rule names an owning role from config/agent-roles.json. A finding with no owner is a complaint.
This audit reads composed output. It cannot see rendered pixels, so it never claims a design is good or bad — that stays with rendered evidence and the design critic.

This audit informs Phase 3.8E; it does not gate it. While the factory is still being built a real run is expected to start from a build that still has findings. Ceilings apply to synthetic canonical fixtures, where they can only catch a regression.
Section roles name real SectionSpec types. A role that names a type the composer cannot emit silently switches its rule off, so an unknown type fails the audit rather than passing quietly.

unresolved-binding.title: A content binding resolved to nothing
unresolved-binding.guidance: The section will render an empty slot. Either bind real content or remove the section.

placeholder-copy.title: Placeholder copy would ship
placeholder-copy.guidance: Lorem ipsum, TBD, 'your company' and example.com are never launchable.

generated-claim-without-source.title: Generated copy makes a claim with no source
generated-claim-without-source.guidance: Generated content may not silently become a factual claim. Bind it to a source fact or soften it.

missing-page-purpose.title: Page has no stated purpose
missing-page-purpose.guidance: Purpose drives the meta description and the page's reason to exist.

duplicate-page-title.title: Two pages share a title
duplicate-page-title.guidance: Duplicate titles read as unfinished and weaken search results.

missing-services-content.title: No services or offering content was available
missing-services-content.guidance: A business site that cannot say what it sells will need hand-written copy.

no-conversion-path.title: The site has no way to convert a visitor
no-conversion-path.guidance: No primary action and no enquiry surface means the build cannot do its job.

missing-contact-details.title: No contact details are available to publish
missing-contact-details.guidance: A visitor who wants to get in touch has nowhere to go.

action-target-missing.title: An action points at a route that does not exist
action-target-missing.guidance: An internal link with no matching page is a dead end in the primary journey.

orphan-page.title: A page is unreachable
orphan-page.guidance: The page is absent from navigation and no action links to it, so nobody will find it.

missing-not-found-route.title: No not-found route
missing-not-found-route.guidance: A mistyped or stale URL should land somewhere deliberate rather than a blank screen.

section-expects-imagery.title: A section that reads as visual has no imagery
section-expects-imagery.guidance: A hero or gallery with no asset is the most common reason a generated site looks unfinished.

no-publishable-imagery.title: No approved imagery is available to publish
no-publishable-imagery.guidance: Supplied assets were absent, unapproved or unusable, so every visual surface falls back to plain layout.

unresolved-capability.title: A requested capability has no implementation
unresolved-capability.guidance: The build cannot claim this capability. Decide explicitly: exclude it or schedule custom work.

custom-capability-pending.title: A capability is marked as custom work
custom-capability-pending.guidance: Custom work is real work. It must be visible in the launch decision rather than discovered later.

knowledge-pack-not-provided.title: No trusted knowledge pack informed this build
knowledge-pack-not-provided.guidance: Without ingested source material the build can only use manifest answers, so copy will be thin and generic.

state-evidence-missing.title: A high-risk surface state has no evidence
state-evidence-missing.guidance: The state is reachable and matters to a user, but nothing proves it renders correctly.

journey-step-unproven.title: A journey step is not proven by composed output
journey-step-unproven.guidance: A component existing is not journey completion. This step needs an executable proof.

content-less-page.title: A page carries no content a visitor came for
content-less-page.guidance: A surface with only a title and a call to action is a dead end. Give it real content or remove it from navigation.

unfillable-surface.title: The factory proposed a surface it had no content for
unfillable-surface.guidance: A default surface with no source-backed content is not published. Supply source material for it, or accept that this project does not need that page.

declared-conversion-unsupported.title: A declared conversion goal has nothing behind it
declared-conversion-unsupported.guidance: Intake named this as a way visitors should reach the business and the approved truth cannot back it — usually a missing contact detail or a missing contact surface. Supply what the channel needs, or drop the goal from intake. It is never silently discarded, and the site never invents the address or number it would need.

declared-proof-missing.title: Proof the operator declared has no source behind it
declared-proof-missing.guidance: The intake said this kind of evidence exists. Ingest it, or the site ships with a proof section it cannot fill. It is never published as a claim on its own.

opportunityRules.description: How findings become at most three ranked improvement opportunities. A broad prompt such as "improve this page" must resolve to things the current build actually needs, not to a redesign. Every opportunity is grounded in findings that already exist, so nothing here invents work.
rules: An opportunity groups findings by the role that owns the fix. That is what makes three opportunities three different things rather than one thing three times.
Value comes from severity: leaving a blocker costs more than leaving a minor.
Frequency counts the distinct places a group touches. The same defect on four pages is worth more than on one.
Readiness says who is blocked. Where the factory has what it needs it can act; where it needs material only the business has, saying so is the useful half of the answer.
Cost and risk are declared per owning role rather than guessed per finding.
Evidence gaps are opportunities to prove something, never defects to fix. They are ranked separately and never counted as predicted edits.
